rationale.intuition: Yale overall ~4.46%, RD ~3.5%, intl admit rate ~3% RD. First-gen intl is a rare profile — Yale need-blind for intl since 2025 cycle removes the financial-aid penalty. Hook stack: first-gen lifts ~1.5-1.8× (NACAC + SFFA) AND intl penalty (~0.6×) partially offsets. Industry consensus 4-12% for first-gen-intl-CN with strong narrative-coded socioeconomic story. Lower bound floors at intl-CN baseline; upper bound caps at first-gen contextual lift over baseline.

sources.name: Yale CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 4.46%; intl admit rate 3-4% in RD; first-gen ~18% of class with admit rate inferred ~6-8% per Yale Daily News 2024.

sources.name: Yale Need-Blind Intl Policy Announcement 2024
sources.evidence: Yale extended need-blind admission to international applicants starting Class of 2029 — eliminates the historical aid-aware penalty for first-gen-intl pool.

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024 §5.3
sources.evidence: First-gen status is rated 'considerable importance' by 30%+ of admissions officers; effect amplified for intl pools where first-gen signals socioeconomic context.

sources.name: Crimson Asia First-Gen Report 2024
sources.evidence: First-gen intl-CN at T5 cluster 5-12% admit rate per published cases — narrower band than domestic first-gen because intl pool is already self-selected, but contextual lift remains real.
